advanced-filter-description: Sefe se tswetseng pele se dumella ho ngola mola o nang le diopereita tsena: == != <= >= && || ( ) Sekgeo se sebediswa ho arola diopereita. O ka sefa dibaka tsohle tse ikgethileng ka mabitso le boleng ba tsona. Mohlala: Field1 == Value1. Ela hloko: Ha dibaka kapa boleng di na le dikgeo, di kenye ka hara matshwao a le mong. Mohlala: 'Field 1' == 'Value 1'. Ho tlola matshwao a taolo, sebedisa backslash. Mohlala: Field1 == I’m. O ka kopanya maemo a mangata. Mohlala: F1 == V1 || F1 == V2. Ka tlwaelo diopereita tsohle di tolokwa ho tloha ho le letshehadi ho ya ho le letona. Fetola tatelano ka masakana. Mohlala: F1 == V1 && ( F2 == V2 || F2 == V3 ). O ka batla le dibaka tsa mongolo ka regex: F1 == /Tes.*/i

import-board-instruction-deck: Kgomaretsa JSON ya boto ya NextCloud Deck (boto e nang le "stacks", stack ka nngwe e na le "cards"). Di-stack di fetoha manane mme dikarete di dula e le dikarete.
import-board-instruction-openproject: Kgomaretsa JSON ya pokello ya work-packages ya OpenProject (GET /api/v3/work_packages). Maemo a fetoha manane mme diphuthelwana tsa mosebetsi di fetoha dikarete.
import-board-instruction-issues: Kgomaretsa lenane la JSON la mathata a __sourceName__ (__endpoint__). Mathata a fetoha dikarete tse hlophisitsweng mananeng a Open / Closed.
import-board-instruction-asana: Kgomaretsa JSON e ntshitsweng ya mesebetsi ya Asana ({ "data": [...] } ho tswa ho Asana kapa GET /tasks). Mesebetsi e hlophiswa ka dikarolo (memberships); e phethilweng e ya ho Done.
import-board-instruction-zenkit: Kgomaretsa JSON e ntshitsweng ya lenane la ZenKit ({ "title", "stages":[...], "items":[...] }). Mekgahlelo e fetoha manane mme dintho di fetoha dikarete.
import-board-instruction-markdown: Kgomaretsa lenane la mesebetsi ea markdown (mokhoa oo lisebelisoa tsa markdown-kanban tse kang Obsidian Kanban li o sebelisang): lihlooho tsa "## Lebitso la lenane", ka lintho tsa "- [ ]"/"- [x]" ka tlase. Lihlooho li fetoha manane 'me lintho li fetoha likarete.
import-board-instruction-leo: Manamisa sebopeho sa Leo (faele ea .leo). Likarolo tsa boemo bo holimo li fetoha manane, likarolo tse tlas'a tsona ka kotloloho li fetoha likarete, 'me mongolo oa karolo o fetoha tlhaloso ea karete. Likarolo tsa maemo a tebileng ho feta li fetoha manane a ho hlahloba. Likarolo tse tšoailoeng li kenngoa e le tse phethiloeng.
import-board-instruction-opml: Paste an OPML outline, as Workflowy, Dynalist, OmniOutliner, Logseq and other outliners export it. Top-level items become lists, their children become cards with the note as the description, and deeper items become checklists. Completed items import as done.
import-board-instruction-orgmode: Paste an Org mode file, as Emacs, Orgzly or Beorg write it. Top-level headings become lists and second-level headings become cards. TODO and DONE, priorities, tags, SCHEDULED, DEADLINE and CLOSED are kept, and checkboxes and deeper headings become checklists.
import-board-instruction-todotxt: Beha faele ea todo.txt: mosebetsi o le mong moleng ka mong, joalokaha sesebelisoa sa todo.txt le lisebelisoa tse lumellanang le sona li ngola. Mesebetsi e phethiloeng ("x") e ea karolong e phethiloeng, +project le @context li fetoha lileibole, (A) e fetoha leibole ea bohlokoa, 'me due: le t: li fetoha matsatsi a ho qetela le a ho qala.
import-board-instruction-taskwarrior: Beha sephetho sa task export: lenane la JSON kapa mosebetsi o le mong moleng ka mong. Mesebetsi e phethilweng e ya ho Done, project le priority di fetoha ditlhaku, annotations e fetoha maikutlo, mme depends e fetoha ho itshetleha ka mesebetsi e thibelang.
import-board-instruction-focalboard: Ntsha faele ya .boardarchive pokellong e peteditsweng mme o behe dikahare tsa board.jsonl ya boto, ka mola wa mofuta kapa ntle le wona. Thepa ya ho arola ka dihlopha ponong ya boto e fetoha manane, thepa e meng ya kgetho e fetoha ditlhaku, dikarolo tsa mongolo le mabokose a ho tshwaya di fetoha tlhaloso le lenane la ho hlahloba, mme maikutlo a bolokwa. Ditshwantsho le difaele tse hoketsweng ha di kenngwe.
import-board-instruction-todoist: In Todoist, open the project menu and choose Export as a template, then paste the CSV file. Sections become lists, tasks become cards, sub-tasks become a checklist, notes become comments, and @labels and priorities p1 to p3 become labels.

globalSearch-instructions-description: Diphuputso di ka kenyelletsa diopereita ho ntlafatsa patlo. Opereita e ngolwa ka lebitso le boleng bo arotsweng ke kolone. Mohlala, `list:Blocked` e lekanyetsa patlo dikareteng tse lenaneng le bitswang *Blocked*. Ha boleng bo na le dikgeo kapa matshwao a ikgethileng, bo lokela ho kenngwa matshwaong a qotso (mohlala `__operator_list__:"To Review"`).
globalSearch-instructions-operator-comme: `__operator_comment__:<text>` - dikarete tse nang le maikutlo a nang le *<text>*.
globalSearch-instructions-operator-label: `__operator_label__:<color>` `__operator_label__:<name>` - dikarete tse nang le leibole e tshwanang le *<color>* kapa *<name>
globalSearch-instructions-operator-creat: `__operator_creator__:<username>` - dikarete moo *<username>* e leng mothehi wa karete

globalSearch-instructions-operator-team: `__operator_team__:<display name|short name>` - dikarete tsa boto e abetsweng sehlopha *<name>*
globalSearch-instructions-operator-due: `__operator_due__:<n>` - dikarete tse lokelang ho phethwa matsatsing a fihlang ho *<n>* ho tloha jwale. `__operator_due__:__predicate_overdue__ e thathamisa dikarete tsohle tse fetilweng ke nako.
globalSearch-instructions-operator-creat: `__operator_created__:<n>` - dikarete tse thehilweng matsatsi a *<n>* a fetileng kapa ka tlase
globalSearch-instructions-operator-modif: `__operator_modified__:<n>` - dikarete tse fetotsweng matsatsi a *<n>* a fetileng kapa ka tlase
globalSearch-instructions-operator-statu: `__operator_status__:<status>` - moo *<status>* e leng e nngwe ya tse latelang:
globalSearch-instructions-status-all: `__predicate_all__` - dikarete tsohle tse Polokelong le tse seng ho yona
globalSearch-instructions-status-ended: `__predicate_ended__` - dikarete tse nang le letsatsi la pheletso
globalSearch-instructions-status-public: `__predicate_public__` - dikarete tse dibotong tsa setjhaba feela
globalSearch-instructions-status-private: `__predicate_private__` - dikarete tse dibotong tsa poraefete feela
globalSearch-instructions-operator-has: `__operator_has__:<field>` - moo *<field>* e leng e nngwe ya `__predicate_attachment__`, `__predicate_checklist__`, `__predicate_description__`, `__predicate_start__`, `__predicate_due__`, `__predicate_end__`, `__predicate_assignee__` kapa `__predicate_member__`. Ho beha `-` pele ho *<field>* ho batla ho se be teng ha boleng sebakeng seo (mohlala `has:-due` e batla dikarete tse se nang letsatsi la ho qetela).
globalSearch-instructions-operator-sort: `__operator_sort__:<sort-name>` - moo *<sort-name>* e leng e nngwe ya `__predicate_due__`, `__predicate_created__` kapa `__predicate_modified__`. Bakeng sa tlhophiso e theohang, beha `-` pele ho lebitso la tlhophiso.
globalSearch-instructions-operator-limit: `__operator_limit__:<n>` - moo *<n>* e leng nomoro e felletseng e ntle e bontshang palo ya dikarete tse bontshwang leqepheng ka leng.
globalSearch-instructions-notes-1: Ho ka hlaloswa diopereita tse ngata.
globalSearch-instructions-notes-2:
Diopereita tse tshwanang di kopanngwa ka *OR*. Dikarete tse tshwanang le boemo bofe kapa bofe di a kgutliswa.
`__operator_list__:Available __operator_list__:Blocked` e kgutlisa dikarete lenaneng lefe kapa lefe le bitswang *Blocked* kapa *Available*.
globalSearch-instructions-notes-3: Diopereita tse fapaneng di kopanngwa ka *AND*. Ho kgutliswa feela dikarete tse tshwanang le diopereita tsohle. `__operator_list__:Available __operator_label__:red` e kgutlisa feela dikarete lenaneng *Available* tse nang le leibole e *red*.
globalSearch-instructions-notes-3-2: Matsatsi a ka hlaloswa e le nomoro e felletseng e ntle kapa e mpe, kapa ka `__predicate_week__`, `__predicate_month__`, `__predicate_quarter__` kapa `__predicate_year__` bakeng sa nako ya jwale.
globalSearch-instructions-notes-4: Diphuputso tsa mongolo ha di kgetholle ditlhaku tse kgolo le tse nyenyane.
globalSearch-instructions-notes-5: Ka kamehla dikarete tse Polokelong ha di batlwe.

database-migration-description: Fetisetsa data e thehilweng mongolong (ntho e nngwe le e nngwe ntle le diphuthelwana le diavatar, tse dulang tsamaisong ya difaele) pakeng tsa MongoDB le FerretDB v1 (SQLite). Polokelo e nngwe ya data e tlameha ho sebetsa le ho fihlelleha (diport tsa kamehla: FerretDB mongodb://127.0.0.1:27018, MongoDB mongodb://127.0.0.1:27019; fetola ka WEKAN_FERRETDB_URL / WEKAN_MONGODB_URL). Ha e qetile, supisa MONGO_URL polokelong e nngwe ya data mme o qale WeKan botjha (ho Snap: snap set wekan database=ferretdb kapa =mongodb).

sandstorm-migration-description: Ha WeKan e sebetsa ka hara grain ya Sandstorm, polokelo ya yona ya kgale ya MongoDB 3 e fetisetswa ho FerretDB v1 (SQLite) ha e qala la pele, mme diphuthelwana le diavatar di fallisetswa ho tswa polokelong ya data ho ya didirectory tsa files/attachments le files/avatars tsa grain. Sena se bontsha hore na phetiso eo e atlehile le hore na difaele tsa kgale tse tala tsa polokelo ya MongoDB di ntse di sebedisa sebaka se sekae sa disk ka hara grain, mme se o dumella ho hlakola difaele tseo tse tala ho lokolla sebaka.

backup-description: Etsa bekapo ya Diphuthelwana, Diavatar le/kapa Data (dipokello tsohle tse thehilweng mongolong tseo e seng diphuthelwana kapa diavatar). .zip e phallela ka kotloloho polokelong e kgethilweng — ha ho faele ya nakwana — e le backup/YYYY/MM/DD/HH_MM_SS/backup.zip, e nang le YYYY_MM_DD-HH_MM_SS/attachments, /avatars le /data. Dipolokelo tsa leru (S3/MinIO, Azure, GCS) di sebedisa mangolo a netefatso a hlophisitsweng ditabeng tsa tsona tsa polokelo.

sync-time-estimate-hint: Time estimates use the numeric original/remaining time fields created by Jira import. Exactly one matching field must exist on this board. Local edits are reviewed as conflicts; missing source values are ignored and explicit null clears the value.
sync-planning-hint: Sprint and releases are synced only while Scrum is enabled on this board. A sprint or release that is missing is created on this board, with the dates the source gives; an existing one is matched by its source ID first, then by name. A local planning change stays until the source changes that issue's planning, and a first Sync never removes planning.
activity-recovery-description: Unfinished notifications are retried automatically. Review missing or changed activities before retrying. Retrying never recreates an activity.
activity-recovery-unavailable: Could not load pending activity notifications.
activity-recovery-status-inconsistent: Plan and pending activity do not match
activity-recovery-busy: Another worker is handling this notification. Refresh and try again.
activity-recovery-denied: Recipient access or notification preferences no longer permit delivery.
activity-recovery-source-unavailable: The original activity is missing or has changed. Nothing was recreated.
activity-recovery-failed: Could not complete notification delivery. Pending work has been retained.
activity-recovery-control-conflict: This notification changed since it was loaded. Review the refreshed state before trying again.
activity-recovery-control-failed: Could not confirm the delivery setting. Refresh and review its current state.
activity-recovery-cancel-confirm: Permanently cancel remaining delivery for this activity? This cannot be resumed. Already queued email and delivered notifications are not recalled.

rule-email-recovery-sent: E amohetsoe ke seva ea imeile
rule-email-recovery-invalid: Lintlha tse hlalosang teko ha lia nepahala
rule-email-recovery-identifiers: Dikhoutu tse khethollang taelo / pitso / teko
rule-email-recovery-empty: Ha ho liteko tsa ho romela liimeile tsa melao tse lumellanang le patlo ena.

rule-email-recovery-resend: Romela hape ho baamoheli ba sa netefatsoang
rule-email-recovery-resend-confirm: Romela imeile ena hape ho baamoheli ba sa netefatsoang? Motho eo seva ea hae ea imeile e amohetseng molaetsa ntle le ho tsebisa WeKan o tla o fumana habeli.

rule-email-recovery-drop-confirm: Hlakola ho romela imeile ena? E ke ke ea romeloa ho baamoheli ba sa netefatsoang.

rule-email-resolution-resend-in-flight: Ho romela hape ha pele ho ka 'na ha tsoela pele. Leka hape hamorao.
rule-email-resolution-nothing-to-resend: Baamoheli bohle ba se ba netefalitsoe. Ho e-na le ho romela hape, e tšoaee e rometsoe.
rule-email-resolution-resend-uncertain: Seva ea imeile ha ea araba. Molaetsa o rometsoeng hape o ka 'na oa fihla kapa oa se fihle; o bontšoa o ntse o tsoela pele.

rule-email-legacy-heading: Liimeile tsa melao tse emetseng tlhahlobo
rule-email-legacy-description: Liimeile tsena tsa melao li lokisitsoe ke mofuta oa khale oa WeKan o sa ngolang hore litaba tsa tsona li tsoa hokae, kahoo WeKan e ke ke ea li romela ka bo eona. rule-email-legacy-discard-confirm: Lahla imeile ena? E ke ke ea romeloa le ka mohla.
rule-email-legacy-empty: Ha ho liimeile tsa melao tse emetseng tlhahlobo.
rule-email-legacy-unavailable: Liimeile tsa melao tse emetseng tlhahlobo ha lia ka tsa laeloa. Khatholla leqephe ho leka hape.
rule-email-legacy-access-denied: Mongoli oa molao ha a sa na tokelo ea ho kena kareteng ena, kapa molao o fetohile, kahoo imeile e ke ke ea hokahanngoa hape. U ka e lahla.

rule-email-legacy-attempt-exists: Imeile ena e se e rometsoe, ho se ho lekiloe ho e romela, kapa e lahliloe.
rule-email-legacy-not-legacy: Imeile ena e se e hokahantsoe hape.
rule-email-legacy-failed: Ketso ena ha ea ka ea phethoa. Khatholla leqephe 'me u leke hape.
stuck-sync-operation-heading: List Sync operations that cannot be replayed
stuck-sync-operation-description: Each of these saved List Sync operations stopped part way and can no longer be finished, because its list was removed, recreated or reconfigured, or the user who started it lost write access. While one is pending, that list cannot Sync. Discard it to let the list Sync again: changes already applied stay, the remaining saved changes are never written, and the next Sync compares the list with its source again.
stuck-sync-operation-reason-scope-change: The list was removed, recreated or its Sync settings changed
stuck-sync-operation-reason-access-denie: The user who started it no longer has write access to the whole list
stuck-sync-operation-reason-trigger-unkn: Saved by an earlier WeKan version without what started it
stuck-sync-operation-reason-intent-missi: The record of who started it is missing
stuck-sync-operation-replayable-now: It can be replayed again now and will finish by itself, so it cannot be discarded.
stuck-sync-operation-discard-confirm: Discard this saved List Sync operation? Changes it already applied stay; the rest are never written. The list can then Sync again.
stuck-sync-operation-empty: No List Sync operations are waiting for review.
stuck-sync-operation-truncated: Only the oldest 50 are shown. Discard some and refresh to see more.
stuck-sync-operation-unavailable: Could not load the List Sync operations. Refresh to try again.
stuck-sync-operation-missing: This operation is no longer pending.
stuck-sync-operation-not-stuck: This operation has not been found stuck, so it cannot be discarded.
stuck-sync-operation-replayable: This operation can be replayed again now and will finish by itself, so it was not discarded.
stuck-sync-operation-busy: This list is syncing right now. Try again in a moment.
stuck-sync-operation-failed: Could not complete this action. Refresh and try again.
interrupted-import-heading: Board imports that stopped before finishing
interrupted-import-description: Each of these board imports stopped part way - the server restarted, or the import failed - and left a partial board. An import cannot be continued, because its source file is not kept. Keep the board as it is, or discard it and import the file again. Discarding removes the board this import created and everything on it, including anything added to it since.
interrupted-import-state-discarding: Being discarded; discard again to finish
interrupted-import-scrum: Its Scrum stage has its own checkpoint (__state__, __next__ of __total__ steps). If you keep the board, finish or discard it from the board's Scrum import recovery.
interrupted-import-counts: __swimlanes__ swimlanes, __lists__ lists, __cards__ cards, __checklists__ checklists, __comments__ comments, __attachments__ attachments
interrupted-import-keep-confirm: Keep this partial board as it is? Nothing is removed, and the import is no longer listed here.
interrupted-import-discard-confirm: Discard this import? The board it created and everything on it are removed permanently.
interrupted-import-empty: No interrupted board imports are waiting for review.
interrupted-import-truncated: Only the oldest 50 are shown. Keep or discard some and refresh to see more.
interrupted-import-unavailable: Could not load the interrupted board imports. Refresh to try again.
interrupted-import-missing: This import is no longer recorded.
interrupted-import-not-interrupted: This import is not waiting for a decision any more.
interrupted-import-foreign-board: The board with this id was not created by this import, so it was not touched.
interrupted-import-scrum-busy: Its Scrum stage is still being written or recovered. Try again in a few minutes.
interrupted-import-failed: Could not complete this action. Refresh and try again.

scrum-history-checkpoint-discard: Keep the board as it is
scrum-history-checkpoint-discard-confirm: Keep every record as it is now, including the changes the stopped operation already wrote?
